what: Ben's Fusion check F4 with Combine: the bar cut by the slot (as combine-f1-slot), then a small block made standing in the slot, then the Combine dragged after it in the timeline and edited. The block is not cut: a Combine's tools and target are the bodies picked, fixed when it was made, and a body made later is never pulled in.

recipe.do: Start a new part and delete its ready-made box (feature-1) from the timeline, as the L bracket's make does, so the counter goes on from 2.
Create Sketch on the front plane XZ (sketch x is X, sketch y is Z, its normal −Y).
Rectangle tool: click (0, 2), then (100, 12) (points 3, 4, 6, 8; lines 5, 7, 9, 10: line 5 the side z = 2, line 7, the second, the side x = 100). Nothing is before it, so nothing is pinned.
Extrude the sketch 20, not flipped (along −Y, y 0 to −20): Body 1, the bar x 0..100, y −20..0, z 2..12 (100 × 20 × 10, Ben's bar).
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.

Rectangle tool: click (30, −25), then (40, 5): the slot, past both of the bar's long sides (points and lines 13 to 20; seen along Z the bar offers its corners (0 or 100, −20 or 0) and its edges' middles (50, 0), (50, −20), (0, −10), (100, −10), none here).
Extrude the sketch 15 (z 0 to 15, past the bar's bottom z = 2 and top z = 12): Body 2, the slot tool x 30..40, y −25..5, z 0..15.
Combine: target Body 1, tool Body 2, Cut, Keep tools off.
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.
Rectangle tool: click (32, −18), then (38, −2) (points 24, 25, 27, 29; lines 26, 28, 30, 31): inside the slot, clear of both pieces' corners and middles.
Extrude the sketch 12 (z 0 to 12): Body 4, standing in the slot, inside where the slot tool was (x 30..40, y −25..5, z 0..15), touching neither piece of the bar.
Drag the Combine (feature-22) after feature-32 on the timeline (24f6 reorder), then open its edit panel: its tool list still holds only Body 2 and its target Body 1. Press OK unchanged.

volume.why: the far piece, 12000, as in combine-f1-slot: 34a rule 1 (Fusion check F1): walking the bar's faces in the order they were made, its caps and the side z = 2 (line 5) are split, and the first wholly in one piece is the side x = 100 (line 7), so the far piece keeps the bar's id body:feature-11 whatever its size.

box.why: slot's far wall to the bar's end

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): every crossing here is between planes at round numbers, exact, so no intersection measures past LINEAR and nothing may grow (B0 decision 5)

volume.why: the near piece, 6000, body:feature-22/piece:1. PREDICTED, check in Fusion: Fusion never reuses a body's number (F2: the tool's left-over piece became Body3), so a new piece after a used-up Body 2 is Body 3; ours today is positional and would say Body 2 (sticky names are a 35e/35f item).

box.why: bar's start to the slot's near wall

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): every crossing here is between planes at round numbers, exact, so no intersection measures past LINEAR and nothing may grow (B0 decision 5)

volume.why: the late block, NOT cut although the Combine now comes after it and its tool would have swallowed it: 6 × 16 × 12 = 1152 (Fusion F4: Body2 not cut). Its name is the one it got when made, kept when the Combine moves before or after it: PREDICTED, check in Fusion; a name worked out from timeline order would turn it into Body 3 after the drag.
